BiblicalUsage: The cedar work is named once, in the ruin of Nineveh. Flocks shall lie down in her midst, the cormorant and the bittern shall lodge in her lintels, and desolation shall be in the thresholds, for He shall uncover the cedar work, stripping the fine panelling from the walls.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for cedar panelling carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the picture, that the richest woodwork of the greatest city ends stripped and roosted in by wild birds.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
